title: [POST_MVP / B-003] Late source association recovery resolves a previously UNKNOWN held commit
post_mvp_reason: Late source association recovery for commits initially held with pr_association_status='UNKNOWN' is deferred to B-003 (POST_MVP).

commits.message: Fix multi-currency tax rounding edge case

details.recovered_pr_title: Fix multi-currency tax rounding edge case

held_items.hold_reason: In MVP snapshot, cmt_syn_1801 has pr_association_status='UNKNOWN' and MUST remain held (never DIRECT_COMMIT / NO_PR).
Late source association recovery linking cmt_syn_1801 to PR #1805 is deferred to B-003 (POST_MVP).

expected_proposal.post_mvp_transition_note: Under B-003 (POST_MVP), applying obs_syn_1801 resolves cmt_syn_1801 from CLASSIFICATION_HELD to a PR_CENTERED Event for PR #1805 without ever having misclassified it as DIRECT_COMMIT.

review_required_items.proposed_value: MVP holds UNKNOWN; B-003 recovers to PR_CENTERED
review_required_items.question: Confirm whether B-003 late association recovery must preserve user curation edits if a user manually acted on a held item, or whether held UNKNOWN items are locked from user curation until recovered (as modeled in EV-013).

rationale.summary: Demonstrates why EV-003 holds UNKNOWN commits instead of emitting DIRECT_COMMIT: late association recovery (B-003, POST_MVP) can later resolve cmt_syn_1801 cleanly into PR #1805 without creating false direct-commit Events or duplicate history.
assumptions_without_notion: Follows prompt instruction to tag late source association recovery as POST_MVP (B-003).
reviewer_questions: Should T-001A include a second POST_MVP variant where late association recovery confirms pr_association_status='NONE' and promotes the held commit to DIRECT_COMMIT?
